name: Agreement 5
definition: Contractual details related to the agreement between parties.

Description.name: Description
Description.definition: Full name of the base standard agreement, annexes and amendments in place between the principals and applicable to this deal.

Date.name: Date
Date.definition: Numeric representation of the day of the month and year.

Currency.name: Currency
Currency.definition: Contractual currency forming the basis of a financing agreement and associated transactions. Usually, but not always, the same as the trade currency.

StartDate.name: Start Date
StartDate.definition: Start date of a financing deal that is the date the buyer pays the seller cash and takes control of the collateral.

MarginRatio.name: Margin Ratio
MarginRatio.definition: Fraction of the cash consideration that must be collateralized, expressed as a percent. A margin ratio of 02% indicates that the value of the collateral (after deducting for "haircut") must exceed the cash consideration by 2%.
